status: APPROVED_BY_USER_2026-10-18 (MOTAR — EQ-1D 결과 검토 및 E-L0 평가 계보 개발 승인); fixed before any E-L0 GPU process
purpose: E-L0 is an evaluation-only lineage: independent records of contact chronology, sensor/observation timing, target identity provenance, association correctness, silhouette visibility classes, tracker age/expiry and episode outcomes, added without changing the actor observation, action, normalisation, perception, tracker, controller, physics or termination of Frozen Policy F.

switch.attachment: kroc_eval_adapter.KrocRecorder builds motar_eval.e_l0.EL0Recorder; the recorder only reads task tensors, chains (never replaces) the env manager's physics-step callback and wraps perception._associate_lidar_target with a call-through that returns the original outputs

records.contact_chronology_100hz: per physics substep: robot contact force norm > collision_force_threshold (0.05 N); per action: number of contact substeps, first contact substep, peak force; per episode: first contact time (s) and substep
records.timing_10hz: per action: env-manager step counter at after_physics, after_perception (observation staged) and before_action (observation consumed); the applied action and command
records.camera_provenance: camera_visible, perception target pixel count, renderer target pixels (detector.target_mask): TRUE_TARGET, FALSE_DETECTION (detection with zero renderer target pixels), MISSED (no detection with >= min_pixels renderer target pixels), NONE
records.lidar_provenance: for each accepted LiDAR association: beam nearest the association bearing, row of the minimum return, LiDAR semantic id there (renderer buffer segmentation_pixels: 50 target, 3 bar, -2 none): CORRECT (50) or FALSE_ASSOCIATION (other); NONE when not accepted
records.fused_validity: camera_visible, lidar_visible, fused visible, track active
records.silhouette_classes: pixel-centre target-alone support (analytic sphere r = 0.15 m on the detector's own ray table and pose, far plane 20 m) and visible support (detector.target_mask), centre-ray mesh query camera->target centre; classes RANGE_EXIT, FOV_EXIT, SCALE_LOSS, FULL, CENTRE_ONLY, PARTIAL, VISIBLE, with attributes centre_in_frustum and below_min_pixels
records.tracker: track age (s), active, expiry events (active -> inactive without a reset)
records.episode: task outcome (capture/crash/timeout, kept), capture_with_contact, collision_free_capture (new column), crash causes from independent evidence (contact substeps, altitude band, OOB bounds), timeout_at_rest (last 1 s speed < 0.1 m/s and nearest-bar clearance >= 0.45 m), safe_abort = NOT_IMPLEMENTED (no abort channel exists; no synthetic event is produced), association counts, label counts

outputs.frames: e_l0_frames.bin (fixed little-endian records, dtype in the summary)

arms.P1: recorder + OCC occlusion trace (the validated OCC telemetry), E-L0 off

run.noninterference_stop: after the three arms of a configuration the orchestrator compares their per-step digests; any mismatch stops the run before the next process (the user's rule: do not proceed, analyse the cause)
integrity_stop: CUDA OOM or GPU memory above the launch-time cap
Policy F / RMS / actor width / import-origin mismatch
run.gpu_memory_cap: total - memory used by other processes at launch - 512 MiB reserve

V1.description: Label fixtures: the 32 EQ-1D D2 scenes (level attitude) plus four association scenes, rendered with the production detector/LiDAR/perception on placed geometry; E-L0's labelling functions run on exactly those frames and are compared with independent CPU oracles (EQ-1A pixel-centre analytic geometry, analytic LiDAR first hit).

extra_scenes.oracle: CORRECT: the target is the first hit on the beam; the camera cannot see it
FALSE_ASSOCIATION: a stale track at the bar's range; the target exists farther along the same beam
NONE: the bar return is about 3 m short of the predicted target surface, outside the gate
NONE: the camera sees the target, so LiDAR association is not attempted

V1.prime_rule: prime 'target': track at the true target centre; 'bar_front' (and every N-scene): at the bar front surface + 0.15 m along the beam; covariance 0.01 I, age 1.0 s; camera_visible from the frame's detection

V2.description: The 24 EQ-1D D1 fixtures at dt 10 ms with both the EQ-1D substep recorder and E-L0's contact chain attached in the same process; E-L0's per-action contact summary compared with the recorder's per-substep force log and with the SAT geometric window (EQ-1D D1-K1 definition).

gates.E0-N1: P2 vs P0, P2 vs P1 and P1 vs P0, every config, every step, every env: 898-D actor observation bytes identical.
gates.E0-N3: Pursuer root state and target position/velocity bytes identical (trajectory identity).
gates.E0-N4: Per-step done flags, capture/crash flags and reset env ids identical (outcome and reset sequence identity).
gates.E0-N5: RMS mean/var/count digest identical to the frozen digest at start and end in every arm.
gates.E0-N6: Sensor (camera RGB/depth, LiDAR range and semantic) and tracker (state, covariance, age, active) checksums identical per step.
gates.E0-L1: V1 silhouette classes: E-L0 class equals the independent pixel-centre oracle class in every target scene (RANGE_EXIT/FOV_EXIT/SCALE_LOSS/FULL/CENTRE_ONLY/PARTIAL/VISIBLE), and E-L0 alone/visible pixel counts equal the oracle counts.
gates.E0-L2: V1 LiDAR provenance: for every accepted association E-L0's label equals the analytic first-hit oracle (target sphere r = 0.20 m vs bars) on that beam; in target-absent scenes every accept is FALSE_ASSOCIATION. The EQ-1D 7/7 false accepts stay a known failure of the production association, not a population false-association rate.
gates.E0-L3: V1 camera provenance: TRUE_TARGET exactly in the scenes where the detector reports the target, no FALSE_DETECTION, and NONE in all target-absent scenes.
gates.E0-C1: V2: E-L0 first-contact substep and contact-substep counts equal the independent recorder's force log, the first contact lies in the D1-K1 SAT window, and non-contact fixtures have zero contact substeps.
gates.E0-C2: V3 P2 episodes: E-L0 outcome equals the task outcome for every episode; collision_free_capture implies capture with zero contact substeps in the episode; every crash has at least one evidence-based cause; safe_abort is NOT_IMPLEMENTED for every episode.
gates.E0-C3: V3 P2 frames: online E-L0 centre-ray blockage agrees with the offline OCC line-of-sight from the recorded trace layouts on >= 99.5 % of in-frustum frames (the G0 renderer-parity standard).
gates.E0-T1: V3 P2: every observation is staged and consumed at the same step counter and E-L0's applied actions equal the launcher's action log bytes.
gates.E0-T2: V3 P2: E-L0 tracker age equals the launcher's tracker age within float16 precision and every recorded expiry is an active->inactive transition without a reset.

development_smoke: Mechanical smoke runs only in the session scratchpad; never evidence; fixtures/gates unchanged by them.
out_of_scope: changes to historical OCC results or populations
